title: `lerp_` of two non-negative tensors produces negative output on MPS on 2.14
body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```python
import torch

# out-of-place torch.lerp fails identically
a = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.float16, device="mps")  # torch.bfloat16 fails too
assert a.lerp_(a + 1, torch.tensor(0.1)) >= 0, "BUG!!!"

# Claude also advises to cross-check with all possible weight dtypes (in the example above, weight dtype is float32), but I did not check the rest
```


### Versions

```
PyTorch version: 2.14.0
OS: macOS 26.6.2 (arm64)
Python version: 3.13.15
Python platform: macOS-26.6.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O
CPU: Apple M4
[pip3] numpy==2.5.2
[pip3] torch==2.14.0
```
